decisions.reason: The footer identifier correction is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including replacement of the obsolete RR-01-only identifier.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the required version-specific identifiers for the headers and footers, along with the separately stated page-one corrections.
Correcting report identifiers in headers does not change the final-page distribution warning's presence, visual treatment, clarity, or footer-interference constraint.
Exposure-band labels are an independent correction in the source message and are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the header identifier change adds nothing further.
Correcting identifiers displayed in report headers does not change the requirement to deliver editable source templates for the four report variants.
The source correction changes displayed version identifiers, not whether customer-specific report fields remain editable.
The internal-header identifier correction does not change the dashboard's displayed result fields, prominence, heading, or communication goal.
The header identifier correction does not affect the content or scannable presentation of the front-page result explanation.
The report-wide premium visual-style requirement remains valid unchanged; a specific identifier correction does not alter its design approach or refinement priorities.
Correcting report identifiers has no effect on the required reusable fonts, icons, or design assets for future editing.
